subject.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts

question: Should Control UI's Import from Relays stop persisting immediately and require the user to select Save & Publish, while explicit HTTP callers may continue using `autoMerge: true`?
rationale: Both interactions are technically supportable, but choosing whether the shipped UI import action is itself a write or only a draft operation is a user-facing product and compatibility decision that source inspection cannot authorize.

options.title: Adopt draft-only UI imports
options.body: Merge the proposed Control UI behavior while preserving the explicit HTTP auto-merge path for callers that intentionally request immediate persistence.

options.title: Retain immediate UI persistence
options.body: Keep the current Control UI interaction and close or redesign this PR around a clearer confirmation or undo workflow.

recommendation.title: Adopt draft-only UI imports
recommendation.body: Merge the proposed Control UI behavior while preserving the explicit HTTP auto-merge path for callers that intentionally request immediate persistence.
